d: What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

WSP is hiring an experienced Site Surveyor to join our Construction Supervision team in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will be responsible for carrying out surveying and setting-out activities, verifying contractor works, and ensuring that all construction elements are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements. The role requires previous experience within a consultancy environment and a strong background in property and buildings projects.
q: Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Surveying, Geomatics, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline.
Minimum 5-8 years of relevant experience, with at least 3 years in consultancy/construction supervision projects.
Proven experience on property and buildings developments, including commercial, residential, mixed-use, hospitality, or institutional projects.
Previous Middle East experience, preferably within Saudi Arabia or GCC countries.
Strong knowledge of construction drawings, specifications, and quality control procedures.
Experience with AutoCAD and survey data processing software.
Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary supervision teams.
Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
